newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal Plus no comment on Premiere report.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus no comment on Premiere report.

text.p: French pay television firm Canal Plus on Monday declined comment on newspaper reports it is on the point of selling its 37.5 percent stake in German pay television channel Premiere to Bavarian media mogul Leo Kirch.
"We have been in negotiations for a very long time. Nothing is signed. We have no comment at this stage," a Canal Plus spokeswoman said in answer to Reuters questions.
Monday's edition of financial daily Les Echos cited different sources saying Canal Plus is planning to swap its Premiere stake for Kirch's 45 percent of Italian pay television group Telepiu.
German magazine Focus said in its weekend edition that Kirch had agreed to buy Canal Plus's Premiere stake, worth about a billion marks, giving him 62.5 percent in Premiere.

A spokesman for Germany's Bertelsmann, which holds the remaining 37.5 percent of Premiere, told Reuters in Munich on Saturday that he was not aware of the deal, but any accord between Kirch and Canal Plus would have to be approved by Bertelsmann.
Canal Plus already owns 45 percent of Telepiu via its subsidiary Nethold, acquired in April.
The scenario of Canal Plus pulling out of its German operations to concentrate on Italy's Telepiu is plausible if Kirch and Bertelsmann agree, a broadcasting industry source told Reuters.
The only other possible option would be Kirch and Bertelsmann each blocking the other, continuing the deadlock over the future of Premiere, this source said.

If Canal Plus bought Kirch's Telepiu stake, giving it 90 percent of the Italian channel, it would seek to sell a fair chunk on to Italian investors, keeping a majority for itself to give it undisputed management of the channel, the source said, declining to give further details.
Any accord between the three media groups would require regulatory approval, the source added.
Such an accord has been flagged by executives of the three groups as necessary to allow the full development of digital services in Germany and Italy.
In Germany, analogue channel Premiere competes with Kirch's own digital service, DF1. Commentators, including Bertelsmann executives, have said there is only room for one digital service in Germany.
